**Compute Sanitizer** is a functional correctness checking suite. This suite contains multiple tools that can perform different type of checks. Tool features are described below.

The **Compute Sanitizer API** enables the creation of sanitizing and tracing tools that target CUDA applications. Examples of such tools are memory and race condition checkers. The Compute Sanitizer API is composed of three APIs: the callback API, the patching API and the memory API. It is delivered as a dynamic library on supported platforms.

### [Memcheck](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/sanitizer-docs/ComputeSanitizer/index.html#memcheck-tool)

The *memcheck* tool is a run time error detection tool for CUDA applications. The tool can precisely detect and report out of bounds and misaligned memory accesses to global, local and shared memory in CUDA applications. It can also detect and report hardware reported error information. In addition, the memcheck tool can detect and report memory leaks in the user application.

### [Racecheck](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/sanitizer-docs/ComputeSanitizer/index.html#racecheck-tool)

The *racecheck* tool is a run time shared memory data access hazard detector. The primary use of this tool is to help identify memory access race conditions in CUDA applications that use shared memory.

In CUDA applications, storage declared with the *__shared__* qualifier is placed on chip *shared memory*. All threads in a thread block can access this per block shared memory. Shared memory goes out of scope when the thread block completes execution. As shared memory is on chip, it is frequently used for inter-thread communication and as a temporary buffer to hold data being processed. As this data is being accessed by multiple threads in parallel, incorrect program assumptions may result in data races. Racecheck is a tool built to identify these hazards and help users write programs free of shared memory races.

Currently, this tool only supports detecting accesses to on-chip shared memory.

### [Initcheck](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/sanitizer-docs/ComputeSanitizer/index.html#initcheck-tool)

The *initcheck* tool is a run time uninitialized device global memory access detector. This tool can identify when device global memory is accessed without it being initialized via device side writes, or via CUDA memcpy and memset API calls.

Currently, this tool only supports detecting accesses to device global memory.

### [Synccheck](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/sanitizer-docs/ComputeSanitizer/index.html#synccheck-tool)

## 1. Invoking compute-sanitizer and the memcheck tool

### Section: "## Compute Sanitizer"

> Compute Sanitizer tools can be invoked by running the `compute-sanitizer` executable as follows:

```
compute-sanitizer [options] app_name [app_options]
```

> For a full list of options that can be specified to compute-sanitizer and their default values, see Command Line Options

### Section: "## Memcheck Tool" → "### Using Memcheck"

> The memcheck tool is enabled by default when running the Compute Sanitizer application. It can also be explicitly enabled by using the `--tool memcheck` option.

```
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]

- 第 1 行：访问的内存段（`__global__` / `__shared__` / `__local__`）、读/写、字节数
- 第 2 行：**kernel 名 + 指令偏移 + 源文件:行号（`memcheck_demo.cu:6` 即越界语句所在行）**——前提是编译加了 `-lineinfo`/`-G`；release 不加行信息时这里只有 kernel 名和偏移，没有行号
- 第 3 行：出错线程坐标 (x,y,z) 与 block 坐标
- 第 4 行：被访问的地址及错误类型（out of bounds / misaligned）

报告还会附 host backtrace（指向触发该 kernel launch 的调用点）和 device backtrace，可以直接看到是源码哪个文件哪一行发起的 launch。

## 5. 常用辅助参数（官方 Command Line Options 表）

| 参数 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `--show-backtrace yes\|host\|device\|no` | yes | 显示/关闭回溯 |
| `--save <file>` / `--log-file <file>` | stdout | 保存输出到文件 |
| `--print-limit <n>` | 100 | 最多打印 n 条错误（0 = 不限）|
| `--num-callers-host/device <n>` | 0（不限）| 回溯打印的帧数 |
| `--kernel-name <...>` | — | 只检查匹配的 kernel（避免无关 kernel 刷屏）|
| `--launch-skip <s>` / `--launch-count <c>` | 0 | 跳过/限定检查的 launch 数 |
| `--generate-coredump` | off | 首个错误处生成 CUDA coredump 并停止（CUDA ≥ 11.6），可用 cuda-gdb 事后分析 |
| `--error-exitcode <n>` | 0 | 便于集成进自动化测试 |

## 6. 进阶（较新 CUDA）：编译期插桩，更快更准

```bash
nvcc -fdevice-sanitize=memcheck -lineinfo -o out in.cu
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck ./out
```

官方说明：`-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` 提供显著性能提升和基于 base-and-bounds 的增强检测；注意它**不隐含生成调试信息**，要行号定位仍必须同时加 `-lineinfo` 或 `-G`。编译期 patching 要求 PTX 编译器与 compute-sanitizer 来自**同一 CUDA toolkit 版本**。直接用 ptxas 时等价旗标为 `-sanitize=memcheck`。

## 排查流程小结

1. `nvcc -Xcompiler -rdynamic -lineinfo -o app app.cu`（需要完整调试用 `-G`）
2. `compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck ./app`
3. 看输出第 2 行 `at kernel():offset in file.cu:LINE` → 即越界语句
4. 用第 3 行线程/block 坐标推出出错的索引计算（如 `tid >= N` 未防护）
5. 报告太长时加 `--print-limit 0 --save out.log`、`--kernel-name` 过滤；难复现的挂 `--generate-coredump`
